technique_name: Provide guidelines for making a presentation about the following topic.
description:
When making a presentation about the effects of global warming on the environment, it is important to thoroughly research and include the latest scientific information.
When beginning the presentation, provide an overview of why global warming is an important issue and its possible near and long term effects on the environment.
